description: This file contains functions for managing and retrieving memory cgroup statistics for cgroup v2, including setting memory limits, reading memory stats, and handling root memory info fallback.

methods.name: numToStr
methods.description: Converts an int64 value to a string for cgroup memory files, mapping -1 to 'max' and 0 to empty string.

methods.name: isMemorySet
methods.description: Checks if any memory resource fields are set in the Resources struct.

methods.name: setMemory
methods.description: Sets memory limits and swap configurations for a cgroup based on Resources.

methods.name: statMemory
methods.description: Reads and updates memory statistics for a cgroup, including handling fallback for root cgroup info.

methods.name: getMemoryDataV2
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage, limit, and max usage data from cgroup v2 files.

methods.name: rootStatsFromMeminfo
methods.description: Fills memory stats from /proc/meminfo for the root cgroup when cgroup files are unavailable.
